mapper.insert: INSERT INTO favorite (user_id, goods_id, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{goodsId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT g.goods_id AS goodsId, g.user_id AS userId, g.category_id AS categoryId, g.goods_name AS goodsName, g.price AS price, g.status AS status, g.view_count AS viewCount, g.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, g.condition_level AS conditionLevel, g.campus AS campus, g.location AS location, f.create_time AS favoriteTime, gi.image_url AS imageUrl FROM favorite f JOIN goods g ON g.goods_id = f.goods_id LEFT JOIN goods_image gi ON gi.image_id = ( SELECT image_id FROM goods_image WHERE goods_id = f.goods_id ORDER BY is_primary DESC, sort_order ASC, image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC, g.goods_id DESC
